chunks: Say: 'Each one awaits; so you wait. You will come to know who are the men of the straight path and who have come to guidance.'
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'Each one awaits' in Surah Taa-Haa?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the concept of *Taqiyya* and divine patience, where the faithful await the manifestation of truth while the arrogant await their reckoning. It underscores that ultimate recognition of the 'Straight Path' (*Sirat al-Sawi*) is reserved for the Hereafter, affirming the certainty of God's promise over the fleeting doubts of the disbelievers.
